particular.en: Britain and the Netherlands, in particular, were competing for influence over the region’s trade.
particular.zh: 尤其是英国和荷兰，在争夺该地区贸易的影响力。

particular.en: Scanning involves searching a wide area with your eyes to find some particular thing.
particular.zh: “观察”（Scanning）包括用眼睛搜索广阔的区域以寻找特定的东西。

particular.en: Despite these benefits, testing, and English testing in particular, has plenty of critics.
particular.zh: 尽管有这些好处，测试，尤其是英语测试，也招来了大量的批评。

particular.en: The worst-case scenario is the worst possible thing that could happen in a particular situation.
particular.zh: 最坏情况（worst-case scenario）是指在特定情况下可能发生的最糟糕的事情。

particular.en: It's only looking at one particular language, one particular app and one particular language school.
particular.zh: 它只着眼于一种特定语言、一款特定应用和一个特定的语言学校。

partner.en: Over the months that I knew him, the financial strain on him and his partner increased.
partner.zh: 在我认识他的几个月里，他和伴侣身上的经济压力越来越大。

partner.en: You could join my conversation clubs, go to a language exchange meeting, find a speaking partner.
partner.zh: 你可以加入我的英语角俱乐部，去参加语言交流会，或者找个语伴。

partner.en: You can get feedback from apps, answer keys, friends, or conversation partners.
partner.zh: 你可以从应用程序、答案解析、朋友或对话伙伴那里获得反馈。

partner.en: Betsy would also involve herself in whatever other ways that they could partner with the family.
partner.zh: Betsy还会以任何其他他们能与该家庭合作的方式参与其中。

partner.en: Canada is the largest trading partner of the United States by far.
partner.zh: 加拿大是美国最大的贸易伙伴，而且远远领先于其他国家。

pacific.en: It has land across the Caribbean, South America, the Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
pacific.zh: 它在加勒比海、南美洲、印度洋和太平洋都拥有领土。

pacific.en: Further south on the Pacific coast of Peru, an even older culture grew.
pacific.zh: 更南边的秘鲁太平洋海岸，孕育了一种更古老的文化。

pacific.en: The other Christmas Island is located in the tiny Pacific nation of Kiribati.
pacific.zh: 另一个圣诞岛位于太平洋上的微型岛国基里巴斯。

pacific.en: France has territory that is scattered across the Atlantic, Caribbean, Indian Ocean, and the Pacific.
pacific.zh: 法国的领地散布在大西洋、加勒比海、印度洋和太平洋。

pacific.en: On the Pacific Coast, some communities relied on fishing and built wooden longhouses.
pacific.zh: 在太平洋海岸，一些社群依靠捕鱼为生，并建造了木制长屋。

particularly.en: It wasn’t particularly difficult. But the UK government is planning to change this significantly.
particularly.zh: 这并不是特别难。但英国政府正计划对此进行重大修改。

particularly.en: Or, if you were being particularly uncharitable, you might translate it as… “big nose.”
particularly.zh: 或者，如果你特别刻薄的话，你也可以把它翻译成……“大鼻子”。

particularly.en: As you may know, that didn’t last particularly long, just 7 months after the invasion.
particularly.zh: 你可能也知道，那并没有持续太久，就在入侵后仅仅7个月。

particularly.en: They have massive reserves of oil, but they’re not particularly efficient at extracting that oil.
particularly.zh: 他们拥有庞大的石油储备，但在开采这些石油方面并不是特别高效。

particularly.en: They particularly moved to what is now Ontario, New Brunswick, and Nova Scotia.
particularly.zh: 他们主要搬到了现在的安大略省、新不伦瑞克省和新斯科舍省。

packet.en: You eat one crisp and before you know it, the whole packet's gone!
packet.zh: 你吃了一片薯片，不知不觉中，整包就没了！

packet.en: Well, I don't think you can beat the smell of a freshly opened packet of ground coffee.
packet.zh: 要说气味，我觉得没有什么能比得上刚打开的一包咖啡粉的香味。

packet.en: I'm a chocolate girl. A packet of biscuits – something like that.
packet.zh: 我是个巧克力女孩。一包饼干——诸如此类的东西。

packet.en: The record for the world's largest packet of crisps was recently broken in Saudi Arabia, but how much did the packet weigh?
packet.zh: 世界上最大包薯片的纪录最近在沙特阿拉伯被打破了，但这包薯片有多重呢？

packet.en: Yes, noodles have changed so much since ancient times that today you can buy them dried in a packet and simply add hot water.
packet.zh: 是的，面条自古以来已经发生了巨大的变化，以至于今天你可以买到一包干面条，然后直接加热水冲泡。

passion.en: And I remember when I was starting out, I was looking for passion.
passion.zh: 我记得刚开始的时候，我在寻找激情。

passion.en: I was in Seattle because I was working, I work with Microsoft, but it's like a passion project.
passion.zh: 我在西雅图是因为我在工作，我和Microsoft合作，但这更像是一个热情项目。

passion.en: Mmm. Being a top chef requires passion, dedication, and hard work.
passion.zh: 嗯。成为一名顶级厨师需要热情、奉献和艰苦的努力。

passion.en: I think it's the combination of the passion and also the skill and athleticism of the players.
passion.zh: 我觉得是激情、球员的球技以及运动能力的结合。

passion.en: That on the one hand, we have thought and reason, and on the other, we have emotions, passions.
passion.zh: 一方面，我们有思想和理性；另一方面，我们有情绪和激情。

paste.en: And finally, guacamole is a paste made of mashed avocado, lime juice and salt – delicious!
paste.zh: 最后，guacamole 是一种由捣碎的牛油果、青柠汁和盐制成的酱——非常美味！

paste.en: Cycling in UAE isn't a copy and paste of cycling in Holland.
paste.zh: 阿联酋的骑行不是对荷兰骑行的简单复制粘贴。

paste.en: You could paste in an article and ask for a summary.
paste.zh: 你可以粘贴一篇文章并要求生成摘要。

paste.en: And finally, a copy and paste is an exact copy of something, which is then moved and put somewhere else.
paste.zh: 最后，“复制粘贴”是指某物的精确复制品，然后被移动并放到其他地方。

paste.en: You write something. You paste it into an AI tool, and the AI will give you a perfect, natural version.
paste.zh: 你写了一些东西。你把它粘贴到人工智能工具中，人工智能就会给你一个完美、自然的版本。

pause.en: Luckily, there are ways to help. If you feel angry when writing an email, pause before you hit send.
pause.zh: 幸运的是，有办法可以帮忙。如果你在写邮件时感到生气，在点击发送前先停顿一下。

pause.en: Before sharing a story or an article or a video, we can pause and ask ourselves… Is this true?
pause.zh: 在分享故事、文章或视频之前，我们可以停顿一下，问问自己……这是真的吗？

pause.en: You know, many people will tell you the story of how they're like, man, during the pandemic, I just like paused.
pause.zh: 你知道，许多人会告诉你他们是如何，就像，伙计，在疫情期间，我只是暂停了。

pause.en: But then, you know, the silver lining of that terrible period for many people was that they got to like, just like pause for a moment.
pause.zh: 但后来，你知道，那个对许多人来说可怕时期的亮点是他们能够，只是像暂停一下。

pause.en: You can practice regulating them. You can practice taking a deep breath, pausing, giving yourself a minute to calm down, and then continuing on.
pause.zh: 你可以练习去调控它们。你可以练习深呼吸，暂停片刻，给自己一分钟平静下来，然后再继续。

payment.en: They even paid some money to the families, a token compensation payment by way of apology.
payment.zh: 他们甚至向这些家庭支付了一些金钱，作为一种象征性的赔偿和道歉方式。

payment.en: I mean, they could barely make the car payment, and now we're giving them a $300,000 to $400,000 house.
payment.zh: 我的意思是，他们几乎连汽车贷款都快还不起了，而我们现在却要给他们一套 300,000 到 400,000 美元的房子。

payment.en: The problem was related to payments. There was no reliable way for one stranger to pay another.
payment.zh: 问题在于支付。当时没有一种可靠的方式让两个陌生人互相付款。

payment.en: The goal today is to figure out how big a mortgage payment Richard can actually afford to pay.
payment.zh: 今天的目标是搞清楚理查德实际上到底能负担得起多大的房贷月供。

payment.en: If you buy something on the never-never, you buy it by making small regular payments over a long period.
payment.zh: 如果你通过“无限期分期”（never-never）买东西，你就是通过长期支付少量定期款项来购买它。

pattern.en: You can notice patterns. You learn vocabulary, and you can recognize the grammar instinctively.
pattern.zh: 你可以注意到规律。你学会了词汇，并且能够本能地识别语法。

pattern.en: What does that mean? A valid environment is one that has rules, patterns, and consistency.
pattern.zh: 这是什么意思？一个有效的环境是指具有规则、模式和一致性的环境。

pattern.en: Despite the difference in medical technology and communication, again the patterns are similar.
pattern.zh: 尽管医疗技术和通讯手段有所不同，但模式再次相似。

pattern.en: It helps you correct mistakes, adjust your strategy, and reinforce the right patterns.
pattern.zh: 它帮助你纠正错误、调整策略并巩固正确的模式。

pattern.en: Their bright colors and unusual patterns made them extremely popular among wealthy people.
pattern.zh: 它们鲜艳的色彩和不寻常的花纹使它们在富人阶层中极为受欢迎。

panic.en: And governments may delay some regulation because of overconfidence or panic after a bubble bursts.
panic.zh: 在泡沫破裂后，由于过度自信或恐慌，政府可能会推迟某些监管。

panic.en: By spring, the panic had grown so big that the local magistrates couldn’t handle it anymore.
panic.zh: 到了春天，恐慌情绪扩散得如此之大，以至于当地治安官再也无法控制局面了。

panic.en: Add in their deep fear of the devil, and it wouldn’t have taken much to spark panic.
panic.zh: 再加上他们对魔鬼的刻骨恐惧，只需要一点微小的火星就能引发恐慌。

panic.en: The garrison collapsed. Some defenders fled into the sea in panic.
panic.zh: 驻军溃败了。一些守军惊慌失措地逃入海中。

panic.en: I think the best thing to do is just not to panic.
panic.zh: 我认为最好的做法是不要惊慌。

package.en: Barbara wants her son to eat healthy, homemade food, although he prefers modern, packaged snacks.
package.zh: Barbara 希望她的儿子吃健康的自制食物，尽管他更喜欢现代包装零食。

package.en: These would be packaged up into beautiful little bottles, not too dissimilar to the stylised bottles that perfume comes in today.
package.zh: 这些香水将被装进美丽的精美小瓶子里，与今天香水采用的时尚瓶子相差无几。

package.en: Again, they're nicely packaged in snack sizes.
package.zh: 同样，它们被精美地包装成零食分量。

package.en: Hmm. I've seen the Netherlands on a lot of food packaging in the UK, so I'm going to say b) the Netherlands.
package.zh: 嗯。我在英国的很多食品包装上都看到过荷兰，所以我要选 b) 荷兰。

package.en: They would make their purchase, in Bitcoin of course, then a few days or weeks later, they would receive a package through the mail which would contain the drugs they had ordered.
package.zh: 他们会进行购买，当然是用比特币，几天或几周后，他们就会在邮件中收到一个包裹，里面装有他们订购的毒品。

patient.en: Ozempic was designed for diabetes, but doctors noticed that patients lost weight as a side effect.
patient.zh: Ozempic 是为糖尿病设计的，但医生注意到患者体重减轻是其副作用。

patient.en: Because now, you and I are being patient for your stock investments.
patient.zh: 因为现在，你和我正在为你的股票投资保持耐心。

patient.en: I'm patient. I'm patient enough to wait forever for that thing to happen. but it's not fun.
patient.zh: 我有耐心。我有足够的耐心去等待那件事发生。但这并不有趣。

patient.en: I'm patient. I'm patient enough to wait forever for that thing to happen. but it's not fun.
patient.zh: 我有耐心。我有足够的耐心去等待那件事发生。但这并不有趣。

patient.en: Well, ultimately, what is patience? Is patience feeling patient or is patient doing the thing that is patience?
patient.zh: 所以Sam Harrison，他与Jocko Willink的第一次谈话大约在10年前，他们谈到勇气是一种无法伪造的情绪。

partly.en: And this is actually partly where the stereotype of British food becoming bad comes from.
partly.zh: 这实际上也是英国食物“难吃”这一刻板印象的部分来源。

partly.en: This is partly because of the historical influence of the United Kingdom and the United States.
partly.zh: 这部分是因为英国和美国在历史上的影响力。

partly.en: Meat was cooked until it was extremely well done, partly due to misunderstandings about food safety.
partly.zh: 肉被煮到熟透甚至变老，部分原因是对食品安全的误解。

partly.en: It was partly practicality—the robes were more suited to the desert—but it was also a symbol.
partly.zh: 这部分是出于实用性——长袍更适合沙漠——但也是一种象征。

partly.en: I think they're at least partly made. There's some genetic aspect.
partly.zh: 我认为至少有一部分是后天造就的。当然也有某种基因层面的因素。

pain.en: If something is a pain to do, it is annoying or difficult to do.
pain.zh: 如果做某事是“a pain to do”，那就是说这件事很烦人或很困难。

pain.en: Now, Milgram was at pains to clarify what his findings did not mean.
pain.zh: 不过，米尔格拉姆也一再费心澄清，他的研究结论并不意味着什么。

pain.en: They twitched and shook, cried out in pain, and complained of being pinched or bitten.
pain.zh: 她们抽搐颤抖，痛苦哭喊，抱怨自己被掐或被咬。

pain.en: If something is a pain to do, it is difficult or annoying to do.
pain.zh: 如果做某事是“a pain to do”，那就是说做这件事很困难或很烦人。

pain.en: In other words, they did believe they were inflicting real pain, but they did it anyway.
pain.zh: 换句话说，他们确实相信自己正在造成真实的痛苦，但他们还是做了。

painful.en: It's so much more painful to watch someone who has no options left.
painful.zh: 看着一个走投无路的人，那种感觉痛苦得多。

painful.en: You can see the entire thing on YouTube, and it is pretty painful to watch.
painful.zh: 你可以在YouTube上看到整段录像，看起来相当令人痛心。

painful.en: The shocks, the experimenter explained, could be painful, but they would cause no permanent damage.
painful.zh: 主试者解释说，这些电击可能会带来痛感，但不会造成永久性伤害。

painful.en: Operations were painful and brutal, and Darwin soon realized that the medical profession wasn’t for him.
painful.zh: 手术过程痛苦且残忍，Darwin很快意识到医学行业并不适合他。

painful.en: If you suffer in silence, you endure and struggle with painful feelings without asking someone for help.
painful.zh: 如果你 suffer in silence（默默承受痛苦），你就是在忍受和挣扎于痛苦的情绪中，却不向任何人寻求帮助。

parcel.en: Some bombs were disguised as parcels, others as pieces of scientific equipment.
parcel.zh: 有些炸弹伪装成包裹，有些伪装成科学仪器。

parcel.en: Part and parcel means to be an essential element or feature of something.
parcel.zh: Part and parcel 的意思是成为某事的重要组成部分或特征。

parcel.en: To be part and parcel of something means to be an essential or integral feature of it.
parcel.zh: 成为某事的 part and parcel 意味着它是该事物必不可少的或不可分割的特征。

parcel.en: Now it was to be transformed. The plan was for the land to be divided into parcels and distributed to settlers from England and Scotland.
parcel.zh: 现在它要被改造了。计划是将土地分成小块，分发给来自英格兰和苏格兰的定居者。

parcel.en: He built a bomb. It was hand-crafted from metal tubing, wood, batteries, and homemade components, it was placed in a parcel and left in a hallway at Northwestern University.
parcel.zh: 他制造了一枚炸弹。它由金属管、木头、电池和自制组件手工制成，被装在一个包裹里，放在西北大学的一个走廊里。

parliament.en: But, and this is an important but, the monarch will never go against Parliament.
parliament.zh: 但是，这是一个重要的“但是”，君主绝不会与议会作对。

parliament.en: Parliament is desperate for the king to recover and is willing to try anything.
parliament.zh: 议会迫切希望国王康复，愿意尝试任何方法。

parliament.en: Labour has a large majority in Parliament and Britain is not holding an election.
parliament.zh: 工党在议会中拥有多数席位，而且英国目前没有举行大选。

parliament.en: This means that there are regional parliaments in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
parliament.zh: 这意味着苏格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰都有地区议会。

parliament.en: Canadian passports mention the King. New members of Parliament swear an oath to the King.
parliament.zh: 加拿大的护照上提到了国王。新当选的议员们也要向国王宣誓效忠。

pan.en: Yes, and Greg uses wok-load as a fun expression, because he's talking about cooking oils and a wok is a kind of pan.
pan.zh: 是的，Greg 用 wok-load 作为一个有趣的表达，因为他在谈论食用油，而 wok（炒锅）是一种锅。

pan.en: She talks about her experience living in the north, and how none of the women cooked their children any proper food; they would either give them money for fish and chips or cook them something all in one pan, and then the poor children would have to eat out of the pan, they would have no plates.
pan.zh: 她谈到了自己在北方的生活经历，说那里的女人们从不给孩子做一顿像样的饭菜；她们要么给孩子钱去买炸鱼薯条，要么把所有东西放在一个锅里乱炖，然后可怜的孩子们只能直接从锅里抓着吃，连盘子都没有。

pan.en: She talks about her experience living in the north, and how none of the women cooked their children any proper food; they would either give them money for fish and chips or cook them something all in one pan, and then the poor children would have to eat out of the pan, they would have no plates.
pan.zh: 她谈到了自己在北方的生活经历，说那里的女人们从不给孩子做一顿像样的饭菜；她们要么给孩子钱去买炸鱼薯条，要么把所有东西放在一个锅里乱炖，然后可怜的孩子们只能直接从锅里抓着吃，连盘子都没有。

pace.en: If someone outpaces you, they are going faster than you – at a higher pace.
pace.zh: 如果有人 outpace 你，他们就是比你走得更快——以更高的速度。

pace.en: Examples of this include animals pacing their cages in circles and rocking, bar-biting, and even self-harm.
pace.zh: 这方面的例子包括动物在笼子里转圈踱步、摇晃、咬栏杆，甚至自残。

pace.en: And rent has increased at a similar pace.
pace.zh: 房租也以类似的速度上涨。

pace.en: Many studies and research have shown that many animals in zoos and aquariums display abnormal behaviours like head-bobbing, pacing, stereotypical behaviours, signs of mental distress.
pace.zh: 许多研究表明，动物园和水族馆里的许多动物会表现出异常行为，如反复点头、踱步、刻板行为以及精神痛苦的迹象。

pace.en: She proudly declared that she had responded, saying, “I do five things in about 10 minutes, and all federal workers should be working at the same pace that President Trump is working and moving.
pace.zh: 她自豪地宣称自己已经回复了，并说道：“我在大约 10 分钟内完成了五件事，所有联邦员工都应该以与特朗普总统相同的工作和推进节奏来工作。

participant.en: The group was whittled down to 24 participants, who were split into two groups.
participant.zh: 最终筛选出 24 名参与者，被分成两组。

participant.en: Another related criticism is that the participants knew they were in an experiment.
participant.zh: 另一个相关的批评是，参与者自己知道他们身处一场实验之中。

participant.en: This study involved long, aggressive interrogation sessions designed to break down the participants’ beliefs.
participant.zh: 这项研究涉及长期、具有攻击性的审讯环节，旨在瓦解参与者的信念。

participant.en: The most serious objection is that participants may not have fully believed the shocks were real.
participant.zh: 最严重的质疑是：参与者可能并没有完全相信电击是真实的。

participant.en: And sixty-five per cent of the participants administered the full 450-volt shock, the maximum voltage.
participant.zh: 而百分之六十五的参与者，一路加到了满格的450伏特——也就是最高电压。

palm.en: One of the hottest places on Earth, Yuma has been experiencing its worst drought in 500 years, forcing farmers to pump water from rivers to grow their date palm trees.
palm.zh: 尤马是地球上最炎热的地方之一，正经历着500年来最严重的干旱，迫使农民从河流中抽水来种植枣椰树。

particle.en: You're like, well, on the universal scale, big bang, particle collisions, no one makes any choices.
particle.zh: 你会想，好吧，在宇宙尺度上，大爆炸，粒子碰撞，没有人做出任何选择。

particle.en: But clay soil is made up of much smaller particles that cling together and naturally stop water from escaping.
particle.zh: 但粘土是由更小的颗粒组成的，这些颗粒紧紧粘在一起，自然地阻止水分流失。

particle.en: Clay soil, on the other hand, is made of smaller particles which cling, or stick together tightly, and hold water, helping plants grow.
particle.zh: 另一方面，粘土由紧密粘连在一起的微小颗粒组成，能够保持水分，帮助植物生长。

panel.en: Enough wind turbines and solar panels could deliver all the energy a country needed.
panel.zh: 只要有足够的风力发电机和太阳能电池板，就能提供一个国家所需的全部能源。

panel.en: His thesis was so advanced that, according to someone on his dissertation panel, "maybe 10 or 12 men in the country understood or appreciated it."
panel.zh: 他的论文是如此先进，以至于根据他论文答辩委员会成员的说法，“全国大概只有 10 到 12 个人能理解或欣赏它。”

panel.en: We need the minerals found on asteroids, especially the platinum group metals, we need them here on Earth, for everything from batteries to solar panels to electric cars, so there is a clear demand.
panel.zh: 我们需要小行星上发现的矿物，尤其是铂族金属，我们在地球上需要它们，用于从电池到太阳能电池板再到电动汽车的方方面面，因此存在着明确的需求。

partial.en: This was a partial success. We reached over 20 million downloads, but only got to 600,000 Spotify followers.
partial.zh: 这是一个部分的成功。我们的下载量突破了 2000 万，但 Spotify 粉丝只达到了 60 万。

partial.en: His health began to decline and he likely suffered from partial paralysis, which made it more difficult for him to continue painting.
partial.zh: 他的健康状况开始恶化，并且很可能患上了部分瘫痪，这使他更难继续画画。

partial.en: Although there was no significant release of radiation, the partial meltdown captured global headlines and rattled public confidence in nuclear energy.
partial.zh: 尽管没有发生大规模的辐射泄漏，但这次局部堆芯熔毁事件占据了全球各大媒体的头条，并动摇了公众对核能的信心。

partial.en: As you may remember, Three Mile Island was the site of a famous partial meltdown back in 1979, but that happened in the other reactor.
partial.zh: 你可能还记得，三哩岛是1979年著名的部分堆芯熔毁事故发生地，但那发生在另一个反应堆。

partial.en: In 2009, a psychologist named Jerry Burger conducted a partial replication at Santa Clara University, stopping the experiment at 150 volts rather than allowing it to continue to the maximum.
partial.zh: 2009年，心理学家杰里·伯格(Jerry Burger)在圣克拉拉大学进行了一次部分复现实验，把实验在150伏特处叫停，而不是让它一直进行到最高电压。

patience.en: It’s a life changing transition. And I want to, kind of, face it with balance and patience.
patience.zh: 这是一次改变人生的过渡。我希望以平衡和耐心的心态去面对它。

patience.en: So patience is a virtue that I feel like I haven't had.
patience.zh: 多年来我一直对自己说这句话。

patience.en: Her work required a lot of patience, precision, and also courage.
patience.zh: 她的工作需要极大的耐心、精确度，还有勇气。

patience.en: Well, ultimately, what is patience? Is patience feeling patient or is patient doing the thing that is patience?
patience.zh: 所以Sam Harrison，他与Jocko Willink的第一次谈话大约在10年前，他们谈到勇气是一种无法伪造的情绪。

patience.en: Punch loses patience and throws it out of the window.
patience.zh: Punch 失去耐心，把它扔出了窗外。

partially.en: Berlin tried strict rent controls, had to partially reverse them, but maintained some protections.
partially.zh: 柏林尝试过严格的租金管制，不得不部分撤回，但保留了一些保护措施。

partially.en: I’ talk about what I achieved, what I only partially achieved, and where I failed.
partially.zh: 我会聊聊我实现了什么，哪些只实现了一部分，以及在哪里失败了。

partially.en: What’s more, they had paid him handsomely, which partially helped explain his unusually lavish lifestyle.
partially.zh: 此外，他们还给了他丰厚的报酬，这在一定程度上解释了他异常奢华的生活方式。

partially.en: I achieved some of these. I partially reached some of my goals.
partially.zh: 其中一些我实现了。一些目标部分实现了。

partially.en: That would be a perfectly reasonable guess, and it’s partially right.
partially.zh: 这是一个非常合理的猜测，而且它部分正确。

passenger.en: Then, he drove stagecoaches: horse-drawn vehicles that carried passengers and mail across long distances before the railways reached everywhere.
passenger.zh: 后来，他又当过驿马车车夫：在铁路还没有铺到各地之前，这种马车负责长途运送乘客和邮件。

path.en: Causeways are raised roads or paths built across water, wet ground, or low land.
path.zh: 堤道是指建在水面、湿地或低洼地带上的高架道路或小径。

path.en: At least for me, I always wanted to take the path of material success first.
path.zh: 至少对我和来说，我总是想先走物质成功这条路。

path.en: But in reality, he had already begun to set himself on a very different path.
path.zh: 但实际上，他已经开始走上一条截然不同的道路。

path.en: It depends on the person, but I think you have to try that path.
path.zh: 这因人而异，但我认为你必须去尝试那条路。

path.en: In terms of possible directions, there are several paths the EU could take.
path.zh: 就可能的发展方向而言，欧盟有几条路径可供选择。

pale.en: The area of reliable English rule, which centred on Dublin, was called the Pale.
pale.zh: 以都柏林为中心、受英国可靠统治的地区被称为“围栏区”（the Pale）。

pale.en: A pale, P-A-L-E, as a noun, is literally a fenced boundary, an enclosure.
pale.zh: “Pale”这个词作为名词，字面意思是栅栏边界或围场。

pale.en: Yes, it might use significantly more energy than things like traditional Google searches, but it is far from the worst thing you can do with a computer, and its environmental impact pales in comparison with most things you do in the real world.
pale.zh: 是的，它消耗的能量可能明显多于传统谷歌搜索等事物，但它远非你用电脑能做出的最糟糕的事情，而且它的环境影响与你在现实世界中所做的大多数事情相比简直不值一提。

partition.en: There were three separate partitions in 1772, 1793, and 1795.
partition.zh: 分别在 1772 年、1793 年和 1795 年进行了三次瓜分。

partition.en: After the final partition, Poland disappeared.
partition.zh: 在最后一次瓜分后，波兰消失了。

partition.en: There is a direct, traceable line from the decision to colonise Ulster in 1610 to the partition of Ireland three hundred years later — the division of the island that you can still see on the map today.
partition.zh: 从 1610 年殖民阿尔斯特的决定，到 300 年后爱尔兰的分治——也就是你今天在地图上仍能看到的岛屿划分——有着直接且可追溯的联系。

pamphlet.en: The pamphlet argued that independence was necessary and logical for the American colonies.
pamphlet.zh: 这本小册子认为，独立对美洲殖民地来说是必要且合乎逻辑的。

pamphlet.en: In early 1776, a pamphlet called Common Sense was written by Thomas Paine.
pamphlet.zh: 1776年初，托马斯·潘恩写了一本名为《常识》的小册子。

pamphlet.en: He had not published a pamphlet, or preached in a public square, or nailed anything to a church door.
pamphlet.zh: 他没有发表小册子，没有在公共广场上演讲，也没有把任何东西钉在教堂大门上。

pamphlet.en: But in 1811, he was expelled from Oxford University for publishing a short pamphlet called "The Necessity of Atheism."
pamphlet.zh: 但在 1811 年，他因出版一本名为《无神论的必要性》的小册子而被牛津大学开除。

paragraph.en: You can highlight a paragraph and get an explanation instantly.
paragraph.zh: 你可以高亮一段文字并立即得到解释。

passive.en: The experience showed me that focused and contextual learning is more effective than passive memorization.
passive.zh: 这段经历向我表明，专注且结合语境的学习比死记硬背更有效。

passive.en: Like the passive voice or the imperative or conditionals, makes language functional.
passive.zh: 比如被动语态、祈使句或条件句，能使语言发挥实际功能。

passive.en: This can turn 20 or 30 minutes of passive listening into an hour plus of active learning.
passive.zh: 这可以将 20 或 30 分钟的被动听力变成一小时以上的主动学习。

passive.en: The prisoners, who were healthy and confident at the start, became passive, anxious, and even traumatised.
passive.zh: 而那些一开始健康又自信的囚犯，则变得被动、焦虑，甚至留下了心理创伤。

passive.en: It’s different from passive repetition. Here’s another example: learning to drive.
passive.zh: 这与被动重复不同。这里有另一个例子：学开车。

patch.en: They even developed " patches " of white fur.
patch.zh: 它们甚至长出了白色的“斑块”。

patch.en: He moved to a patch of remote land outside the tiny town of Lincoln, Montana, where he built, with his own hands, a tiny wooden cabin.
patch.zh: 他搬到了蒙大拿州小镇林肯郊外的一片偏远土地上，在那里亲手建造了一间小木屋。

patch.en: Sunak has until January of 2025 to call a general election, he has two years to rebuild trust and patch up the damage from the most chaotic period of recent British political history.
patch.zh: Sunak 在2025年1月之前必须举行大选，他有两年的时间来重建信任，并弥补英国近代政治史上最混乱时期造成的损害。

paw.en: From tools to companions. With their roles redundant, they were allowed to put their paws up and relax.
paw.zh: 从工具变成了伴侣。随着它们的工作岗位被淘汰，它们终于可以把爪子翘起来好好放松一下了。

paradox.en: None of the original wood remained. And this created a puzzle or a paradox.
paradox.zh: 原来的木头一点也没有剩下。这就产生了一个谜题或悖论。

paradox.en: And this is sometimes the paradox that we struggle with in our lives as people.
paradox.zh: 这有时是我们作为人所挣扎的悖论。

paradox.en: This is known as the resource curse, or you might hear it called the paradox of plenty.
paradox.zh: 这就是所谓的资源诅咒，或者你可能会听到它被称为“丰饶的悖论”。

paradox.en: A paradox is a situation that seems to contradict common sense.
paradox.zh: 悖论是指一种似乎与常识相矛盾的情况。

paradox.en: Have I told you about the region beta paradox?
paradox.zh: 我跟你说过贝塔区域悖论吗？

participate.en: The biggest reason is integration. Language is the key to participating in society.
participate.zh: 最重要的原因是融入。语言是参与社会的钥匙。

participate.en: They participate in the Thinking in English conversation clubs on Tuesdays and Wednesdays.
participate.zh: 他们参加周二和周三的《Thinking in English》英语角俱乐部。

participate.en: But now, under the new republic, they were encouraged to work, study, and participate in politics.
participate.zh: 但现在，在新共和国的体制下，她们被鼓励工作、学习并参与政治。

participate.en: And this campaign became enormous. The organizers claim that tens of millions of people participated worldwide.
participate.zh: 这项活动变得规模空前。组织者声称全球有数千万人参与。

participate.en: Thousands of workers and craftsmen participated in the project over many years.
participate.zh: 数以千计的工人和工匠历时多年参与了这一项目。

parameter.en: And because AI systems are so large, with billions of parameters or virtual “connections” between artificial neurons, they need vast amounts of energy both to train them and to run them.
parameter.zh: 而且，由于人工智能系统规模如此庞大，拥有数十亿个参数或人工神经元之间的虚拟“连接”，它们无论是训练还是运行都需要大量的能量。

patriotic.en: Most probably, this was done by an officer called Heinz Brandt, who just pushed the briefcase with his feet, not out of any great patriotic duty, but because it was in the way of where he wanted to put his legs.
patriotic.zh: 极有可能是海因茨·勃兰特（Heinz Brandt）这位军官做的，他用脚把公文包踢到了一边，倒不是出于什么伟大的爱国主义责任，而是因为它挡住了他想放脚的地方。

painting.en: And so we came together in that way, yes, and it was while painting my house.
painting.zh: 于是我们就这样走到了一起，没错，就是在粉刷我家房子的时候。

painting.en: The elevator had this big graffiti painting on it that was awesome.
painting.zh: 电梯上有一幅很酷的大涂鸦画。

painting.en: A graffiti painting, meaning like, that had been there since before you guys moved in?
painting.zh: 涂鸦画，意思是，那是你们搬进去之前就有的吗？

painting.en: Before he began painting, Leonardo would create detailed sketches and studies.
painting.zh: 在开始作画之前，列奥纳多会创作详细的草图和研究。

painting.en: And it is again, one of the most famous paintings in history.
painting.zh: 它再次成为历史上最著名的画作之一。

paradise.en: Christmas Island is a tropical paradise with a history of colonial exploitation, forced labor, wartime occupation, and a controversial refugee detention program.
paradise.zh: 圣诞岛是一个热带天堂，却有着一段殖民剥削、强迫劳动、战时占领以及充满争议的难民拘留计划的历史。

paradise.en: This was a true libertarian paradise, a place where people were allowed to make their own choices about what to buy and what to put into their bodies without the government poking its nose in.
paradise.zh: 这是一个真正的自由意志主义天堂，一个允许人们在没有政府插手干预的情况下，自己决定买什么以及把什么东西放进自己身体里的地方。

paradise.en: He kept that fact a secret for 20 years because Jehovah's Witnesses believe that sometime in the near future, when Jehovah God cleanses the earth and remakes it into the paradise that it once was, those who have not faithfully obeyed his word will be destroyed.
paradise.zh: 他把这个事实保守了20年，因为耶和华见证人相信，在不久的将来，当耶和华上帝洁净地球并将其重新创造为昔日的乐园时，那些没有忠实顺从他话语的人将被毁灭。

parade.en: On the 6th of October, 1981, Egypt’s third president, Anwar Sadat, was assassinated during a military parade.
parade.zh: 1981 年 10 月 6 日，埃及第三任总统 Anwar Sadat 在一次阅兵式上遇刺身亡。

parade.en: People who’ve never visited Brazil can probably picture Copacabana Beach, or the giant statue of Christ the Redeemer, or Rio’s colorful carnival parades.
parade.zh: 从未访问过巴西的人大概也能想象出科帕卡巴纳海滩、巨大的救世主基督像，或是里约五彩斑斓的狂欢节游行。

parade.en: The Nazi regime used Berlin as a stage. It was the place where they held their mass rallies and their military parades, and also carefully controlled public events designed to project strength and unity.
parade.zh: 纳粹政权将柏林作为一个舞台。这是他们举行群众集会、阅兵式以及精心控制的旨在彰显力量和团结的公共活动的地方。

parallel.en: He said he'd been overwhelmed and had created a parallel personality for himself.
parallel.zh: 他说自己当时不堪重负，为自己创造了一个平行人格。

parallel.en: When an instructor said something like, “stop at the intersection”, or “please parallel park”, I was expected to follow instructions immediately, of course.
parallel.zh: 当教练说出诸如“在路口停车”或“请侧方停车”之类的话时，我当然必须立即执行指令。

patron.en: I have a community on a website called “Patreon” where you can become a “patron”.
patron.zh: 我在一个叫做“Patreon”的网站上有一个社区，你可以在那里成为一名“赞助人”。

patron.en: These moves were often connected to work, as he relied on wealthy patrons to support him.
patron.zh: 这些搬迁通常与工作有关，因为他依赖富有的赞助人来养活自己。

parachute.en: For example, he sketched things that resembled helicopters and parachutes.
parachute.zh: 例如，他画了一些类似于直升机和降落伞的东西。

paralysis.en: His health began to decline and he likely suffered from partial paralysis, which made it more difficult for him to continue painting.
paralysis.zh: 他的健康状况开始恶化，并且很可能患上了部分瘫痪，这使他更难继续画画。

patrol.en: The Berlin Wall was actually a network of concrete barriers, guard towers, flood lights, alarm systems, and patrol roads.
patrol.zh: 柏林墙实际上是一个由混凝土屏障、岗楼、探照灯、报警系统和巡逻路组成的网络。

pave.en: It paved the way for modern genetics, ecology, and even parts of medicine.
pave.zh: 它为现代遗传学、生态学甚至是部分医学铺平了道路。

pave.en: They had a really advanced drainage system, and they had paved streets that were wide and open, almost like you get in modern cities today.
pave.zh: 他们拥有非常先进的排水系统，并且拥有宽敞开阔的铺装街道，几乎就像你们今天在现代城市中看到的那样。

paralyze.en: Perhaps you fell blinded by rage or paralyzed by fear.
paralyze.zh: 也许你曾被愤怒蒙蔽，或是被恐惧困住。

pat.en: And I got so angry. You? So angry. And you can hear Layla patting my back.
pat.zh: 我当时非常生气。你？是的，非常生气。你可以听到Layla在拍我的背。

pat.en: I think too many people forget the pats on the back and the hugs and the encouragements and the load liftings, they forget all of it.
pat.zh: 我认为太多人忘记了拍拍肩膀、拥抱和鼓励以及减轻负担，他们忘记了这一切。

paradoxically.en: So paradoxically, you would go two miles quicker than you would go one mile.
paradoxically.zh: 所以反常的是，你走两英里所花的时间，反而会比走一英里还要快。

pad.en: Zygonic? oh wow this is way more than i do that's what you shut up that's what you're leveraging here so um the zygonic effect was a study originally done on servers in restaurants okay and they realized you've ever been at a restaurant and a server comes up and stands with the hands behind the back and go what would you like tonight sir and you say i'll have the lobster roll and a glass of red wine and a blah blah and you're like this motherfucker's not he hasn't got a pen or a pad of paper.
pad.zh: 蔡加尼克？哦，哇，这比我知道的要多得多，这就是你在这里利用的东西。所以，嗯，蔡加尼克效应最初是对餐馆服务员的一项研究，好的。他们意识到你有没有去过餐馆，服务员走过来，双手背在身后，说：先生，今晚你想点什么？你说：我要龙虾卷和一杯红酒，还有巴拉巴拉，你就像：这个混蛋，他没有笔或纸垫。
